title: The howler monkey genome provides new insights into the distinctive howling and folivorous adaptations of New World monkeys.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: paper_context.py: not in Europe PMC full text (no PMCID), no supplement listing, no text-mined accessions, no NCBI links, no Zenodo/Dryad hits. NCBI Assembly search for Alouatta macconnelli returns only GCA_963573945.1 (PGDP_AloMac, scaffold-level, contig N50 29,721 bp, released 2023 by IBE Barcelona), which is an earlier short-read assembly from the Primate Genome Diversity Project, not this paper's long-read genome.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: From the abstract only: a HiFi (high-fidelity long-read) genome of the Guyanan red howler monkey, population resequencing across Alouatta species, positive-selection and regulatory scans, and enzyme assays on duplicated FBP1 paralogs. Where the new assembly and resequencing data are deposited was not found.

a1_downloadable.note: This paper's assembly and resequencing data could not be located: no full text, no accessions, no repository hits. Only an unrelated 2023 short-read assembly is in NCBI. Checked via APIs.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: A genome assembly plus population genomics has no prediction target; any label (selection signals, introgression) would have to be constructed by our own analysis. Judged from abstract.

a3_inputs_present.note: Inputs would be raw genome and resequencing reads (outside policy) or an assembly FASTA; no feature table. Not checked in files.

a4_units_stated.note: No measured tabular quantity to carry units; the FBP1 enzyme assays are a handful of experiments.

a5_enough_rows.note: One species genome plus a small number of resequenced individuals (count not seen); the enzyme assays cover a few paralogs, far below 400 labelled rows.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: Primate genome ~3 GB FASTA plus resequencing reads (tens to hundreds of GB)
a6_fits_laptop.note: Genomics-scale; deprioritized by size rules. Estimated, not checked.

a8_label_provenance.note: Candidate labels (positively selected genes, introgression tracts) are outputs of statistical models run on the same sequences, so they are circular.

honest_claim_h3: No ML claim is possible: this is a single-species genome assembly and evolutionary analysis with no labelled table.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use howler monkey genome sequence to predict which genes were shaped by leaf-eating or loud-calling adaptation.
plain_idea.train_on: Gene or regulatory-region sequences from one new monkey genome; number of labelled examples unknown and likely tiny.
plain_idea.predict: Whether a gene is under lineage-specific selection, a label the authors computed with evolutionary statistics on the same sequences, not a measurement.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Would interest primate evolution researchers, but the project is not well defined: the label is circular and the data were not found.

ml_idea: None viable; a genome assembly paper with no measured label table.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; project rejected at Part A.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Look for any tabular labelled dataset in the data availability statement; none found via APIs.

verdict_reason: Single-species genome assembly paper: no label column, no tabular data, data location not found, and genomics-scale working set (A1, A2, A5, A6 fail).
